describe.description: The creature is a single four-legged equid shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. It has a stocky, donkey-like body with a shaggy brownish-gray coat that is lighter on the belly and white around the muzzle and nostrils, a short erect dark mane along the back of the neck, two large upright ears, and a thin tail with a dark tuft at the tip. Dark brown to black striping overlays much of the body, most prominently on the hindquarters, mid-back, shoulder, neck and lower legs, with a continuous dark dorsal stripe along the spine and a vertical shoulder stripe. It stands with all four legs visible in a natural standing pose.

describe.description: A slender four-legged equid standing in side profile facing right, with a donkey-like body and head but with zebra-like striping. It has a brownish-gray shaggy coat with a pale belly and white muzzle, long slender legs, a thin tufted tail, two large upright ears, and a short erect bristly mane along the neck. Dark narrow stripes mark the hindquarters, legs, shoulder, neck, and back.
